what: A two-line uppercase title filling the pinned panel top to bottom is bound to scroll. The top line moves up and the bottom line down (middle text height ÷ 2 + 54px) while shrinking to .82x (the top line around its lower 75% point, the bottom line around its upper 25% point). With progress .1 late, the text in the gap opens from the center up and down (inset 50% → 0). With exit, the two lines then shrink a further .9x and leave the screen (±50vh).

options.start: Start, default ‹top top› — to spread apart after holding for one screen, use ‹top top-=100%」
options.max: Upper limit of the smallest scale, default .82
options.gap: Extra gap added to half the text height (px), default 54
options.lag: Progress delay before the text starts to open (0~1), default .1
options.exit: If ”true”, it spreads apart and then exits off-screen
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Sticky panel (the element itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=copy]: Text that opens in the gap (optional)
